title: Apolipoprotein E4 and immune dysfunction in Alzheimer’s disease: mechanisms and therapeutic implications
title_zh: 载脂蛋白E4与阿尔茨海默病中的免疫功能障碍：机制与治疗意义
abstract: Emerging evidence suggests that apolipoprotein E4 (APOE4) functions as an organizer of brain-periphery immune crosstalk, coupling maladaptive microglial states with peripheral immune remodeling to establish a self-reinforcing neuroimmune loop that may accelerate the progression of Alzheimer's disease. In the central nervous system, APOE4 pushes microglia away from homeostatic surveillance toward metabolically stressed, inflammatory, and synaptotoxic phenotypes, thereby weakening pathological protein clearance and promoting neurodegeneration. In the periphery, APOE4 primes innate and adaptive immune cells toward a pro-inflammatory state, creating a reservoir that can communicate with the diseased brain and infiltrate it. In addition, APOE4 erodes the separation between central and peripheral immune compartments, enabling bidirectional immune crosstalk that amplifies neuroinflammation and neurodegeneration. In this review, we synthesize evidence for APOE4-driven central and peripheral immune dysregulation; discuss therapeutic opportunities for targeting the APOE4 immune axis; and highlight the need for human-derived, longitudinal, cross-tissue studies to identify causal, stage-specific, and targetable immune nodes for precision intervention.
abstract_zh: 新兴证据表明，载脂蛋白E4（APOE4）在脑-外周免疫互作中起组织者作用，将不适应的微胶质细胞状态与外周免疫重塑耦合，形成自我强化的神经免疫循环，可能加速阿尔茨海默病的进展。在中枢神经系统中，APOE4使微胶质细胞远离稳态监测，转向代谢压力、炎症和突触毒性表型，从而削弱病理蛋白清除并促进神经退行性变。在外周，APOE4使先天和适应性免疫细胞倾向于促炎状态，形成可与受损大脑沟通并渗透其内的储备。除此之外，APOE4侵蚀中枢与外周免疫区块之间的分隔，促成双向免疫互作，放大神经炎症与神经退行性变。在本综述中，我们综合了APOE4驱动的中枢与外周免疫失调证据；讨论针对APOE4免疫轴的治疗机会；并强调需要人源、纵向、跨组织研究，以识别因果、阶段特异且可靶向的免疫节点，实现精准干预。
